items.claim: Parallax intro undoes a per-plane-zoom toggle made while it plays
items.note: The same closure also jumped the planes' anchor to 0 when the box was toggled mid-intro. Both the intro frame and the toggle now read the last written state, and each changes only its own half.

items.claim: PTouchLabelDemo's Download swallows a failure that Print reports
items.note: Both buttons now put their result or error on the status line through one shared helper.

items.claim: PathMotionDemo keeps the last ride's tilt after "turn with the path" is unticked
items.note: Each ride now starts from rotation 0.

items.claim: PlotKindsDemo keys the chart by kind but not its data panel
items.note: The panel now takes `key={kind}`. The leak only happens when you go back to a kind that has already loaded. On a first visit the panel unmounts while that kind loads, so the test goes gantt → pie → gantt.
